<function name="DecalMaterial" parent="util" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Gets the full material path by the decal name. Used with <page>util.DecalEx</page>.

If decal specifies multiple materials, a random one will be chosen.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="decalName" type="string">Name of the decal.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="string">Material path of the decal.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
